clue.text: Aromatic seasoning of fish with student in charge

explanation.surface: A cookery note about a pungent sauce for fish, made with a student overseeing it.
explanation.definitionFit: This pungent bulb is used everywhere as a flavouring in cooking, so it is an aromatic seasoning.

clue.text: Of US region merest wind disrupted

clue.text: Raised vessel's advance payment

parts.note: an etna is a small vessel for heating liquids

explanation.surface: Someone lifts a ship, or perhaps a pot, and talks about paying in advance.
explanation.walkthrough: The etna, named after the volcano, is a little spirit-burner vessel familiar mainly from crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: In poker the stake each player puts in before the cards are dealt is a payment made in advance.

clue.text: With start of snows this peninsula becomes harsh place of exile

parts.note: the frozen Russian region where exiles and prisoners were sent

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter, so only that is kept

parts.note: the opening letter of the word snows

explanation.surface: A travel note: add snow to this sunny peninsula and it turns into a bleak place of banishment.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue works backwards: the answer with an S in front becomes SIBERIA, so the solver removes that S from the place of exile to find IBERIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Iberia is the name for the European peninsula shared by Spain and Portugal, which 'this peninsula' points to.

clue.text: Awkward moments absorbing Yankee — plastic for credit card is one of them

definitions.text: plastic for credit card is one of them

indicators.note: to absorb something is to take it inside, so one piece goes within the other
something awkward is clumsy and out of shape, so the letters that follow are rearranged

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged
Yankee is Y in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: An embarrassing time for an American, sharing a moment about paying by card.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a whole example: calling a credit card 'plastic' names it by its material, which is exactly the figure of speech meant.
explanation.definitionFit: A metonym names something by a thing closely associated with it, as 'plastic' stands for a credit card or 'the Crown' for the monarch.

clue.text: About cuppa raised in Acciano regularly, ordinary drink for locals

parts.note: C stands for circa, Latin for about

indicators.note: in a down entry, something raised is read upwards, so the word is turned backwards

parts.note: a cuppa is a British word for a cup of tea, used here as written

indicators.note: taking letters at regular intervals means keeping every other one

parts.note: the second, fourth and sixth letters of the village name
O is the abbreviation for ordinary, as in O level

explanation.surface: Someone in an Italian village lifts their tea, while the residents order their usual coffee.
explanation.walkthrough: Acciano is a small village in Italy, which is why the coffee is a drink 'for locals'.
explanation.definitionFit: Cappuccino is the Italian espresso coffee topped with frothed milk, the everyday drink of the people there.

clue.text: Greek characters fully satisfy in retrospect

indicators.note: retrospect means looking back, so the word is read from its end to its start

parts.note: to sate is to satisfy completely

explanation.surface: Looking back, the Greek figures of a story proved wholly satisfying.
explanation.definitionFit: Eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet, so the plural names Greek letters, or characters.

clue.text: Frame of crossword feature; very hard

parts.note: the grid is the pattern of squares a crossword is printed in
iron is a byword for hardness, as in an iron will

explanation.surface: A solver comments on the structure of a crossword and finds it extremely difficult.
explanation.definitionFit: A gridiron is a frame of parallel metal bars, such as a grill for cooking or the framework over a stage.

clue.text: Foreigner, having considerable skill, capable of being transferred

parts.note: an alien is a foreign national
to be able is to have real skill or competence

explanation.surface: A talented immigrant described as someone who could be moved to another post.
explanation.definitionFit: In law, property that is alienable can have its ownership passed to someone else.

clue.text: Modify church communion table, we're told

parts.note: the altar is the communion table in a church

explanation.surface: A proposal to change the arrangement of the communion table in church.
explanation.definitionFit: To alter something is to change it, the same as modifying it.

clue.text: Base equipment that's needed to get car moving

definitions.text: that's needed to get car moving

parts.note: base in the sense of mean or lowly
gear is kit or equipment

explanation.surface: A list of the basic kit a driver needs to start a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A car is started in first, the lowest gear, which gives the most pulling power from rest.

clue.text: Resisted work put forward

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a musical work
to pose a question is to put it forward

clue.text: Army scout troubled according to habit

clue.text: Dubiously respect one hidden thing that is known to all

definitions.text: hidden thing that is known to all

indicators.note: done dubiously means done in a questionable, irregular way, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the ten letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone half-heartedly respects a person with a secret that everybody knows.
explanation.definitionFit: An open secret is something meant to be confidential that in fact is common knowledge, a paradox the definition spells out.

clue.text: Councillor not oddly hires Republican for official announcer

parts.note: Cr is the abbreviation for councillor

indicators.note: dropping the odd-numbered letters leaves only the even-placed ones

parts.note: the second and fourth letters of hires
R is the abbreviation for Republican

explanation.walkthrough: 'Not oddly' looks as if it qualifies the councillor, but it acts on the following word.
explanation.definitionFit: A town crier was the official who called out public proclamations in the streets.

clue.text: Breach within part of unit

parts.note: within means in
a fraction is a part of a whole, or of one

explanation.definitionFit: An infraction is a breaking of a rule or law, which is a breach.

clue.text: Person under stress, barely honest, meeting Santa's little helper?

explanation.surface: A stressed, not-quite-truthful person bumping into one of Santa's helpers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Under stress' points to the emphatic use, as in 'one must do it oneself', where the word is said with stress.
explanation.definitionFit: Oneself is the reflexive form of the indefinite person 'one', given extra stress when used for emphasis.

clue.text: Too chill, put out waterproof material

parts.note: the eight letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: It is too cold, so get out the rainproof fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Oilcloth is cotton cloth treated with oil to keep water out, used for tablecloths and covers.

clue.text: For me, including Ena produces this, as an example

a woman's name, taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: Ena does double duty: it goes inside the container, and it is itself an example of what the answer names.
explanation.definitionFit: Ena is a given name, and a first or given name is exactly what a forename is.

clue.text: Become more inflexible in small row with gutless Englishman

explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' is the rhyming-with-cow kind: a quarrel, not a line.
explanation.definitionFit: To stiffen is to grow stiffer, so it means becoming less flexible, physically or in attitude.

clue.text: In St Andrews briskly trips along golf course by the sea

explanation.definitionFit: In Scots the verb means to walk briskly, and in golf the noun is a course on coastal dunes such as the Old Course.

clue.text: Logic shown in way to minimise alcohol intake?

clue.text: Cold's terrible, gripping somebody deprived of winter fuel payment?

definitions.text: somebody deprived of winter fuel payment

clue.text: Insult hospital food
